title: Accenti
text: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || Accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo || vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti || etaṃ bhayaṃ {maraṇe} pekkhamāno || puññāni kayirātha sukhāvahānīti || || Accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo || vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti || etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno || lokāmisaṃ pajahe santipekkho ti || ||
